newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - COWEN DETAILS EDS CUT.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - COWEN DETAILS EDS CUT.

text.p: Cowen & Co analyst Hugh Shytle said he downgraded Electronic Data Systems Corp to underperform from neutral.
-- said EDS appears less confident in its base business and less confident about its General Motors Corp business.
-- said EDS' revenue growth outlook appears somewhat "sluggish."
-- said EDS has "no trigger" that would spark optimism in the stock and has "no visibility" on its earnings outlook.
-- said investors should "go to the sidelines and wait for a sign to jump in again."
-- On Thursday, EDS said it expected an erosion of revenues and earnings to deflate 1997 earnings to a range of $1.90 to $2.00 a share.
